The socks feature a distinct ribbed or cable-knit pattern and appear to be made of a soft, possibly wool or synthetic blend material. There is a small dark embroidered detail on the outer ankle of the right sock. The feet are resting on a wooden floor with visible grain.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the toe regions. AI often struggles with the subtle bulges of toes inside tight fabric. If the toes look completely flat or fused, flag it. Also, verify if the knit pattern wraps logically around the cylindrical shape of the leg without weird warping at the seams.
